description: A single row payload for upsert/create. Include `:deleted: true` to delete a row by its identifier. Include `:id` (or the dataset's row identifier column) to target an existing row for update. Omit both to create a new row.

:id.description: Internal Socrata row ID to target for update/delete.

:deleted.description: Set to `true` to delete the row matching this row's identifier.
